lines.en: He telephoned me four times yesterday, and three times the day before yesterday.
lines.zh: 他昨天给我打了 4 次电话，前天打了 3 次。

lines.en: He telephoned the office yesterday morning and yesterday afternoon.
lines.zh: 他昨天上午和下午把电话打到了我的办公室，

lines.en: What did your boss say to him?

lines.speaker: Pauline
lines.en: She can't speak to you now!'

lines.speaker: Pauline
lines.en: Then I arrived home at six o'clock yesterday evening.
lines.zh: 后来，我昨晚 6 点钟回到家里。

lines.speaker: Pauline
lines.en: But I didn't answer the phone!

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.en: Did he telephone again last night?
lines.zh: 他昨天夜里又打电话了吗？

lines.speaker: Pauline
lines.zh: 他在 9 点钟又打来了电话。

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.en: What did you say to him?

lines.speaker: Pauline
lines.en: Please don't telephone my daughter again!'
lines.zh: 请不要再给我女儿打电话了！”
